Main Courses and credits Each student must complete 54 credits of courses including 36 compulsory, 18 elective and 8 for a practicum requirement. More majors will be offered as enrollment expands such as Accounting and East Asian Studies (jointly offered with Nagoya University and Soongsil University) Compulsory Courses Credits Elective Courses Credits Principles of Management 3 Strategic Management 2 Principles of Marketing 3 Cross-cultural Management 2 Introduction to Financial Accounting 3 Operation Management 2 Corporate Finance 3 Human Resources Management 2 Organizational Behavior 3 Intermediate Microeconomics 3 Business Research 3 Managerial Accounting 2 Consumer Behavior 2 Financial Statement Analysis 2 Global Marketing 2 Investment Analysis 2 Service Marketing 2 Leadership 2 Marketing Channels 2 Chinese Business Law 2 Business to Business Marketing 2 International Business Environment 2 Advertising and Promotion 2 International Trade Practice 3 Data Model and Decision Making 2 International Finance 2 International Corporate Finance 2 Transnational Management 2 Internship and Career Development UIBE has special apartment to help international student find internship and employ chances in good companies and organizations. Marketing graduates can engage in market research, marketing planning, advertising planning, market development, marketing management, marketing services and teaching and research, etc. Thesis In the fourth year of their study, students must complete a thesis related to their major to meet the graduation requirements. The length of the thesis should be around 8000 words. The thesis is a milestone assessment on the intended level of achievement both in the major and the general learning outcomes by the students. Specifically, students, must demonstrate the ability to apply their learning to complex, unscripted problems in the context of their advanced studies, the mastery of the skills required for their disciplines as well as essential learning outcomes including the breadth and the depth of their knowledge, critical and creative thinking, problem solving, the ability to integrate knowledge and skills and present their work in an appropriate manner.
